title: Database Migration and Data Movement
description: Plan and execute database migrations to Azure using Azure Database Migration Service and common data movement strategies.

data.text: Moving data to Azure is a common task. Whether you are migrating a SQL Server database to Azure SQL, exporting Cosmos DB data, or moving files between storage accounts, Azure provides tools that minimize downtime and data loss.

Azure Database Migration Service is a fully managed service that migrates databases from on-premises or other cloud providers to Azure. It supports SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. DMS handles schema conversion, data migration, and post-migration validation.

data.title: Create a DMS Instance with Azure CLI
data.content: Provision a Standard tier Database Migration Service
data.code:
az dms create \
  --name dms-demo \
  --resource-group rg-demo \
  --location eastus \
  --sku S0

data.text: The right migration strategy depends on your downtime tolerance, data size, and application architecture.

You can also move data between Azure Storage services. **AzCopy** is a command-line tool that copies blobs, files, or table data between storage accounts or to/from local disk. For recurring jobs, use **Azure Data Factory** or **Azure Synapse Pipelines**.

data.title: Export Cosmos DB Data with Azure CLI
data.content: Trigger a Cosmos DB account backup to a storage account
data.code:
az cosmosdb update \
  --name cosmos-demo \
  --resource-group rg-demo \
  --backup-interval 1440 \
  --backup-retention 30 \
  --backup-storage-redundancy Geo

data.title: Always Test Migrations
data.text: Run migrations in a non-production environment first. Validate schema compatibility, row counts, and application behavior before switching production traffic.

data.title: Exercise: Plan a Migration
data.description: Design a migration plan for a sample database.
steps: You have a 50 GB on-premises SQL Server database with 24/7 uptime requirements.
Choose a migration strategy and justify it.
List the tools you would use and the order of operations.
Define rollback criteria in case the migration fails.
Write a brief communication plan for stakeholders.
data.expectedOutcome: A complete migration plan covering strategy, tools, rollback, and stakeholder communication.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: DMS is the primary tool for online database migrations to Azure.
Choose a migration strategy based on downtime tolerance and data size.
AzCopy and Data Factory handle storage-to-storage data movement.
Always validate data and test rollback before migrating production.
data.takeaway: Database migration is a planned process, not a one-click action. Preparation and testing determine success.
